  year = 2021:2025,
  value = c(100, 104, 103, 108, 112)
)

ggplot(example_data, aes(year, value)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#002060", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(colour = "#ff6f00", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Example chart",
    subtitle = "Replace with the relevant period",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: replace with source"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
